scope: label-free temporal site-evidence architecture selected only on authorized cross-site development folds

search.formula: logit(current_scene_score) + weight * mean(site top-k current-scene logits)

gates.selection: combined AP and recall improve, AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance
gates.confirmation: same fixed candidate has combined AP and recall improve, AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance

interpretation.architecture_hypothesis_source: transparent diagnosis after prior exact-paper failures showed a recurring unseen-site transfer problem

invariants: No label, country, coordinate, paper split, or training-site membership is used by the inference formula.
Physical-site aggregation uses only the already frozen current scene scores available at inference.
The 18 candidates, rank rule, confirmation gates, seeds, and output paths are frozen before development scoring.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh-safety or paper replay.
